blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — Eastern Samar is stepping up preparations for the possible impacts of a developing El Niño phenomenon, with water security, agriculture, public health, and fire prevention among its major concerns. While the province is still assessing the extent of the potential impact, officials are already putting measures in place as weather forecasts indicate drier conditions in the coming months. One of the local governments taking early action is the municipality of Llorente, where officials are scouting for potential watershed areas that could serve as additional sources of potable water for the community.
